model.name: Per-change RESOLVED-state toggle (green checkmark: outlined=unresolved / solid=resolved)
model.description: A per-change RESOLVED-STATE toggle: a GREEN CHECKMARK (labelled 'RESOLVED') sits next to the up/down nav in the 3-Way Merge toolbar for the current change. OUTLINED-green = UNRESOLVED; SOLID-green = RESOLVED. Clicking the checkmark TOGGLES the change's resolved state. Clicking ANY merge action (x / >> / <<) on that change RESETS it to UNRESOLVED (an action means you're re-working it). Resolution is EXPLICIT via the checkmark - it is NOT auto-set by an action. Drives the R30.36 open-count (open = unresolved). Client-facing -> version-bump + atomic deploy (R30.28). WORDING is 'RESOLVED' (button/label/tooltip) - never 'commit'/'committed'. There is ONE resolved-state per CHANGE: even when a change renders as 2 SVG blocks (R30.35 two-per-side rendering), it is ONE change with ONE checkmark and ONE resolved-state - resolve/unresolve applies to the whole change, not per-block.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each change shows a GREEN CHECKMARK labelled 'RESOLVED' (button/label/tooltip say 'RESOLVED' - NEVER 'commit'/'committed') next to the up/down nav in the 3-Way Merge toolbar for the current change.
OUTLINED-green = UNRESOLVED; SOLID-green = RESOLVED. The checkmark's fill visually distinguishes the two states (pixel-distinguishable).
Clicking the checkmark TOGGLES the change between resolved and unresolved. Resolution is EXPLICIT via the checkmark - it is NOT auto-set by a merge action.

There is ONE resolved-state per CHANGE. Even when a change renders as TWO SVG blocks (the R30.35 two-per-side rendering), it is ONE change with ONE checkmark and ONE resolved-state - resolving/unresolving applies to the whole change, NOT per block. 2 blocks = VISUAL only, not 2 resolve targets.
Clicking ANY merge action (x / >> / <<) on that change RESETS it to UNRESOLVED (re-working the change un-resolves it).
The resolved state drives R30.36's open-count (open = unresolved): resolving via checkmark decrements it, an action resetting a resolved change increments it.
GATE: checkmark toggles resolved (outlined<->solid, pixel-distinguishable); an action resets to unresolved; the open-count tracks accordingly. Client-facing -> version-bump.
